LESSON: VISUAL PROGRAMMING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.4: Visual Programming

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Visual Programming
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are computer programs used in day-to-day life?
